checked_sources: Independent Python exhaustive re-enumeration, finite K3,3 graph
correctness.rationale: The ordinary Morse complex of K3,3 is the acyclic vertex-edge matching complex, equivalently outdegree≤1 directed rooted forests. An independently written enumerator exhausted 4^6 per-vertex choices and found exactly 1791 nonempty simplices, face vector (18,126,432,729,486). Augmented mod-2 boundary ranks (1,17,109,323,406) saturate successively the rational upper bounds given by ∂²=0, proving H̃4(Q) has dimension 80 and all other reduced rational homology vanishes. Exact signed Lefschetz enumeration of all 72 automorphisms reproduced nine conjugacy traces (80,0,2,0,0,5,-4,0,-1), with orientation parity cross-check, and rational character inner products gave irreducible multiplicities (1,2,1,2,4,5,3,4,4). Nine irreducible characters are orthonormal, squared dimensions sum to 72 and weighted multiplicities sum to 80; invariant dimension = (sum traces)/72 =1. Pure side interchange has −4 trace and eigendimensions 38,42. Independent finite enumeration proves this one finite group/complex, not a family. This agrees with the inspected analytic proof and the included verifier design; a VERIFY_OK log alone was not relied on.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not generalize to K_{m,n} for other m,n.

evidence: A published balanced K_{m,m} formula gives diagonal bipartition-swap trace (-1)^m(m-1)^(m-1), hence -4 at m=3 and, with prior dimension 80, dimensions 38 and 42; these particular assertions are covered.
The same balanced K_{m,m} paper provides a full 20-conjugacy-class table only at m=4; no full class-character formula at m=3 is stated.
The K_{2,n} equivariant Euler-character theorem is for unequal left-side size 2, hence does not specialize to K_{3,3}.
Jojić (2012) covers K_{m,n} nonequivariant homotopy but not its full equivariant homology decomposition.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The universal diagonal-interchange theorem is genuine stronger prior coverage of one audited trace and its two eigendimensions. It does not imply the remaining eight K3,3 class traces nor the complete irreducible multiplicity vector. The other general families either determine nonequivariant homotopy or involve different bipartite parameters.

originality.rationale: The full nine-class rational K3,3 character and nine rational irreducible multiplicities survive best-of-knowledge literature comparison. Jojić (2012) already determines the non-equivariant K3,3 80-sphere homotopy type; Lin–Scoville identifies the abstract automorphism group; the published all-m balanced-Kmm theorem already proves the K3,3 pure swap trace −4 and resulting 38/42 eigenspaces. Those components are excluded from any novelty claim. Unlike these earlier or parallel results, the remaining eight class traces and complete module decomposition were not found in read full texts or semantic searches. Related K2,n and K2,4 representation results do not dominate K3,3. No chronology or priority is inferred; unindexed equivariant calculations remain possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently titled equivariant computation could reproduce all nine K3,3 class values; searches and primary reading cannot prove universal absence.

Same-date balanced Kmm theorem already proves the swap trace and eigenspace dimensions and Jojić (2012) proves the homotopy type. Novelty is only the full nine-class module beyond them; no timing/priority inference is made.
Exact integer lattice and equivariant homotopy type are not determined by rational representation data.

value.rationale: K3,3 is the smallest balanced complete bipartite graph with substantial 80-dimensional reduced top homology, a canonical test object for ordinary discrete Morse complexes. Its natural full 72-element automorphism action has a complete rational module and invariant line, beyond the previously known Betti number/group identification and one involution trace; this offers exact equivariant topological data for naturality and comparisons with other graph Morse complexes. The complete module is a motivated natural finite classification rather than an arbitrary isolated statistic. Scope is rational homology for this graph only, not integral action or general Kmm formula.
residual_risks: Future usefulness of exact character beyond equivariant comparisons is plausible rather than a proved downstream theorem.

limitations: Some subclaims are provably prior: Jojić 2012 already has 80-sphere homotopy; published balanced Kmm theorem gives swap trace −4 and eigendims 38/42.
Original novelty assessed only for full nine-class character and irreducible constituents, best of knowledge; unindexed equivalence possible.
Full result is rational finite K3,3 only; no new integral homology representation, infinite parameter statement or equivariant homotopy.
Public package has private/provenance defects; completed science verdict is not a publishable release.
